japan1.description: ことしの「骨太の方針」の原案がまとまり、「責任ある積極財政」の考え方のもと、強い経済の実現に向けて国内投資の拡大や供給力の強化を打ち出しています。また、民間投資を引き出すため「財政単年度主義」の弊害を是正し、財政運営の目標は債務残高の対GDP比を安定的に低下させることを中核に位置づけています。

japan1.title: 記録的水準の円安 今後は？暮らしはどうなる？【詳しく】
japan1.description: 続く円安の傾向。30日の東京外国為替市場、円相場は1ドル＝162円台前半と、およそ39年半ぶりの円安ドル高水準になりました。今後の見通しは。暮らしへの影響は。専門家の分析や、仕入れコストの上昇に悩む現場など、円安に関するニュースをまとめてお伝えします。

japan1.title: 7月の食品値上げ2566品目 5年連続で1万品目超えの見通しも
japan1.description: 7月に値上げされる食品は2500品目余りに上ることが民間の調査会社のまとめで分かりました。調査した会社では、中東情勢の影響でコストが上昇した分を価格に転嫁する動きが続いていることから、企業による値上げの動きは秋ごろまで続くとみています。

japan1.title: 5月の原油輸入量 前年比38％減 代替調達で4月より減少幅は縮小
japan1.description: 資源エネルギー庁は、5月、日本に輸入された原油は729万キロリットルと去年より38％減ったと発表しました。ホルムズ海峡を通らないルートでの調達の拡大で、ことし4月に比べると減少の幅は縮小しました。

japan1.title: 6月の月例経済報告 「緩やかに回復」を維持
japan1.description: 政府は、6月の月例経済報告で景気の現状について「緩やかに回復しているが、中東情勢の影響を注視する必要がある」として、5月の基調判断を維持しました。個別の項目をみますと、「輸出」は東南アジア向けの半導体製造装置の出荷が増加していることなどを受けて「このところ持ち直しの動きがみられる」に1年4か月ぶりに上方修正したほか、「倒産件数」は去年まで続いていた増加傾向が足元で一服しているとして、「おおむね横ばいとなっている」に1年5か月ぶりに上方修正しました。

japan1.title: 日本航空 “空飛ぶクルマ”研究めぐり補助金を不正受給
japan1.description: 日本航空は「空飛ぶクルマ」やドローンの研究事業をめぐり、およそ5年にわたって労務費の水増しなどで国からの補助金、2億8000万円余りを不正に受け取っていたと発表しました。

japan1.title: “AIロボット 製造業などの分野で1000万台規模に” 政府新目標
japan1.description: 人手不足が深刻化するなか、経済産業省は2040年までに製造業や医療をはじめとする18の分野で、あわせて1000万台規模のAIを搭載したロボットを導入する目標を新たに掲げました。

japan1.title: 株価 一時1000円以上値上がり AIや半導体関連銘柄に買い注文
japan1.description: 6月30日の東京株式市場、このところ値下がりしていたAIや半導体関連の銘柄を中心に買い戻しの動きが出て、日経平均株価は一時、1000円以上値上がりしました。

japan1.title: アフラック生命 約438万人分 個人情報漏えい 一部は口座情報も
japan1.description: がん保険を手がけるアフラック生命は、保険内容を確認する契約者専用サイトのシステムなどが不正アクセスを受け、名前や住所、電話番号などの個人情報、およそ438万人分が漏えいしたと明らかにしました。今のところ漏えいした情報の不正利用は確認されていないとしています。

japan1.title: 北陸新幹線延伸 京都府・市からは懸念など相次ぐ
japan1.description: 北陸新幹線の新大阪までの延伸ルートを議論する与党の委員会が開かれ、出席した京都府知事と京都市長からは地元の理解や財政負担に関する懸念が表明されました。

japan1.title: 西武池袋本店が入る建物を一部改装 家電量販大手が新店舗
japan1.description: 東京 池袋にある「西武池袋本店」が入る建物の一部で改装を進めていた家電量販大手のヨドバシホールディングスは、新しい店舗をオープンさせました。地元からの懸念の声や工事の遅れなどもあって、土地や建物の取得から2年半以上たっての開業になります。

japan1.title: ペルシャ湾内の日本関係船舶 新たに3隻がホルムズ海峡通過
japan1.description: 金子国土交通大臣は、6月30日の閣議のあとの会見で、ペルシャ湾内にとどまっていた日本関係の船舶のうち新たに3隻がホルムズ海峡を通過したと明らかにしました。いずれも乗組員の健康状態に問題はなく、船体に異常はないということです。

japan1.title: 【きょうのおはBiz 6月30日(火)】ペットの暑さ対策に商機

aus1.title: Usman Khawaja helps launch national Islamophobia awareness campaign
aus1.description: The retired 39-year-old, who was the first Muslim to play international cricket for Australia, says Islamophobia is on the rise, with women most vulnerable to attacks, because "hate is more prevalent that it has been before".

aus1.title: Study finds NT residents are the nation's happiest
aus1.description: Northern Territory residents are the happiest in the nation, a new university study has found, with access to nature, warm weather and cultural diversity among the theories for Territorians' sunny attitudes.

aus1.title: This Liberal took his teacher to gambling anonymous
aus1.description: When Liberal backbencher Simon Kennedy was a teenager, one of his high school teachers asked to borrow money for his gambling addiction. He says he ended up accompanying the teacher to Gamblers Anonymous meetings.

aus1.title: Fears for Perth man missing in Mexico for almost a month
aus1.description: Jesse Bruzzese's family say the 35-year-old solo traveller has not been in touch with them since arriving in Mexico at the beginning of June.

aus1.title: Basketball coach abused girl at primary school during training session, court told
aus1.description: Shannon Trew, 42, indecently dealt with a young girl he was training at a primary school, a Perth court hears.

aus1.title: Final report finds Avalon stunt pilot was too low before crash
aus1.description: A report from the Australian Transport Safety Bureau into a crash at the Avalon Airshow last year will result in changes to how low stunt pilots can fly at the event.

aus1.title: Pair get temporary ban on keeping dogs after RSPCA inspection
aus1.description: Two people have been convicted and disqualified from owning dogs for five years after a severely emaciated dog was rescued by RSPCA inspectors and nursed back to health.

aus1.title: Uni's HR chief tells ICAC she was 'shocked' by promotion proposal
aus1.description: Corruption watchdog hears University of Wollongong Chancellor Michael Still rejected calls to advertise a proposed executive role for chief governance officer.

aus1.title: Whale census records unexplained drop in sightings off WA's South West
aus1.description: Marine scientists have expressed concerns following a 60 per cent drop in migrating whales seen off South West WA's coastline compared to previous years.

aus1.title: A girlfriend who never existed and fake friends. How Graham became a money mule
aus1.description: Graham Guy was the victim of a romance scam and had his bank accounts drained over several years. Then came an unusual request that unwittingly drew him into crime.

aus1.title: Menswear brand accused of using AI to 'whitewash' model's image
aus1.description: Australian model Elii Emeghebo is pursuing a racial discrimination complaint against suit label Peter Jackson, claiming AI has been used to "whitewash" his image.

aus1.description: Legally Blonde was an overwhelming hit, so what do critics think of the prequel Elle?

aus1.title: Childcare centre that exposed kids to rat poison stripped of funding
aus1.description: The Melbourne childcare provider has been cut off under new powers that allow the federal government to withdraw funding due to safety breaches.

aus1.title: CSIRO tests show even 10 'detention' basins cannot 'flood-proof' city
aus1.description: CSIRO modelling shows even the construction of 10 upstream 'detentions' would not have spared Lismore from the 2022 floods.

aus1.title: Qld seat redistribution turns drive to MP's office from 15 minutes to 11 hours
aus1.description: There is widespread anger among voters of an abolished Queensland electorate who will potentially face an 11-hour drive to their local MP's office.

aus1.description: The TGA issues a warning for consumers using sexual enhancement products after an investigation finds several products contain undeclared prescription drugs that could cause serious side effects.

aus1.description: The Adelaide Thunderbirds are looking to win their third premiership in four years, with co-captain Georgie Horjus putting their success down to strong team connections on and off the court.

aus1.title: Helicopter spotlight a 'shining light' for stranded fisherman
aus1.description: After more than four hours floating in rough seas, 77-year-old John "Stinker" Clarke was starting to lose hope. Then he saw a light from above.

aus1.title: 'No place for the poison of antisemitism': New warning for universities
aus1.description: The government's Antisemitism Education Taskforce, led by David Gonski, has equipped teachers with new resources to tackle antisemitism and promote "Australian values".

aus1.title: Australian horticulture production value hits record $19.5b
aus1.description: The value of Australia's horticulture sector has more than doubled in a decade, according to data released today by the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

aus1.description: A sporting league in regional Victoria is the first to adopt a concussion app aimed at improving communication and accountability around concussions at grassroots sports.

aus1.description: Uber has defended slugging riders who require extra assistance with a "disability tax", amid ongoing criticism over how it treats people with disability.

aus1.description: The aging blast furnace at the Whyalla steelworks could be permanently shut down before the steelworks transitions to a direct-reduced iron plant and electric arc furnace, placing hundreds of jobs at risk.

aus1.title: Paediatrician accused of child sex offences now facing 53 charges

bang3.description: The administration of Chittagong University yesterday claimed to have identified two persons who sexually assaulted a female student on the campus on Sunday night.

bang3.title: Rohingya genocide case to proceed
bang3.description: The World Court yesterday rejected Myanmar’s objections to a genocide case over its treatment of the Muslim Rohingya minority, paving the way for the case to be heard in full.

bang3.title: Need 1 week to assess situation
bang3.description: Admitting that the Power Division could not impose schedule-wise power cuts across the country, State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid yesterday sought one week’s time to address the issue.

bang3.title: Wasfia 1st Bangladeshi to conquer K2
bang3.description: Renowned Bangladeshi mountaineer Wasfia Nazreen conquered the treacherous K2 in Pakistan, becoming the first person from Bangladesh to summit the second-tallest mountain in the world.

bang3.title: CU sexual assault: Fingers pointed at BCL men
bang3.description: Those who sexually assaulted a female student on Chittagong University campus on July 17 night are members of Bangladesh Chhatra League, said police sources and CU BCL insiders.

bang3.title: Noab hikes newspaper price by Tk 2 from Jul 25
bang3.description: All newspapers owned by the members of Newspaper Owners’ Association of Bangladesh (Noab) will see a price increase of at least Tk 2 per issue from July 25.

bang3.title: Yet-to-start mega projects: Consider putting  them on hold
bang3.description: Given the current economic situation, the government should consider suspending mega projects the physical work of which has yet to begin, economist Debapriya Bhattacharya said yesterday.

bang3.title: ‘You cannot remain silent’
bang3.description: The High Court yesterday came down hard on Bangladesh Railway for mismanagement, ticket scalping and carrying passengers on the train roofs.

bang3.title: Electricity crisis may worsen
bang3.description: The government’s plan for one to two hours of daily power cuts is failing, especially in the north, and the signs are that the electricity crisis may worsen across the country in the coming days.

bang3.title: EC’s dialogue hits a snag as BNP skips it
bang3.description: The BNP yesterday skipped Election Commission’s dialogue seeking recommendations of political parties on how to hold a free and fair general election.
